biography:
High performing, sales executive with 20+ years of experience across cloud, data center, software, network, and the evolving AI industry. Consistently ranked in the top 1% of sales achievers, excelling at industry leaders like Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Equinix, as well as PE-backed high-growth firms acquired by major players, including Savvis (Lumen), Yipes (Reliance), Telx (Digital Realty), and Xand (TierPoint). 

Recognized for shaping go-to-market strategies, expanding high-profile accounts, and mobilizing global teams to drive exceptional outcomes. Proven ability to secure complex, high-value deals across enterprise, mid-market, and startup segments. Expert in revenue growth, product-market fits, process optimization, and cross-functional alignment to accelerate scaling and strategic exits. Dedicated to cultivating a high-trust, high-performance culture fueled by innovation, continuous learning, and customer obsession.
